Streamer.title: Streamer
Streamer.description: Profile and payment settings for a streamer.

promptpayId.description: The PromptPay ID (mobile phone or identity card) configured by the streamer.

promptpayName.description: The verified holding name of the PromptPay account.

bio.description: A description/greeting displayed on the payment link page.

overlaySound.description: Audio name or URL played on OBS overlay.

minDonationAlert.description: Minimum THB value to trigger animation and voice alerts on stream.

ttsEnabled.description: Whether to synthesize and read aloud donation messages on stream.

Donation.title: Donation
Donation.description: A PromptPay donation alert with transactional validation state.

amount.description: Donation transfer amount in Thai Baht.

message.description: Message to display overlay notification on streamer's screen.

triggered.description: Whether the notification was already processed by the stream overlay websocket/onSnapshot loop.

slipVerified.description: Whether the slip image was uploaded and verified successfully by the AI parser.

slipParsed.description: JSON representation of the verified bank slip values scanned by Gemini.

/streamers/{streamerId}.description: The master profile document representing a registered game streamer or billing account.

/streamers/{streamerId}/donations/{donat.description: Individual donation alert item. Created by general public donors; managed and fetched by the streamer and real-time overlays.
